fields.label: Taxpayer Registration Code
fields.description: Latvian taxpayer registration code (nodokļu maksātāja reģistrācijas kods). For a natural person who has a Latvian personal identity number, the taxpayer registration code is identical to that personal identity number; other registered taxpayers are assigned an 11-digit registration code.

fields.label: VAT Registration Number
fields.description: Latvian Value Added Tax (PVN) registration number, consisting of the country prefix LV followed by 11 digits.
